req.title: Player update persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall write updates to the players table so subsequent GET calls reflect the modification.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that PUT /players/{squadNumber} must persist updates so subsequent GET calls reflect the change. The source reveals a deliberate bug: update_by_squad_number_async always returns False after commit (line: `return False` instead of `return True`), which causes the route to raise HTTP 500. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — valid full update returns 204 and GET reflects new data; (2) negative NEG — mismatched squad_number in body vs path returns 400; (3) negative NEG — update non-existent player returns 404; (4) DT — squad_number mismatch body/path boundary; (5) STC — state transition: create then update then GET verifies persistence; (6) BVA — squad_number boundary at minimum existing value (1). Each test asserts exact HTTP status codes and exact response field values to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_put_valid_player_returns_204_and_get_reflects_update
preconditions: DB contains player with squadNumber=10 (Lionel Messi)
App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: PUT /players/squadnumber/10 with updated first_name='Leo' and all required fields
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_put_valid_player_returns_204_and_get_reflects_update():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Leo",
        "lastName": "Messi",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": True,
        "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z"
    }
    put_resp = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=payload)
    assert put_resp.status_code == 204
    get_resp = client.get("/players/squadnumber/10")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    body = get_resp.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Leo"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Messi"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 10
    assert body["position"] == "Right Winger"
    assert body["starting11"] == True

test_put_valid_player_returns_204_and_get_reflects_update()

tests.name: test_put_state_transition_create_update_get
preconditions: DB does NOT contain a player with squadNumber=50
App is running in-process via TestClient
actions: POST /players/ to create player with squadNumber=50
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_put_state_transition_create_update_get():
    client = TestClient(app)
    create_payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Original",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Centre-Back"
    }
    post_resp = client.post("/players/", json=create_payload)
    assert post_resp.status_code == 201
    update_payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Updated",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Centre-Back",
        "team": "New Team"
    }
    put_resp = client.put("/players/squadnumber/50", json=update_payload)
    assert put_resp.status_code == 204
    get_resp = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    body = get_resp.json()
    assert body["lastName"] == "Updated"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert body["team"] == "New Team"

test_put_state_transition_create_update_get()
